home.metaTitle: Online auctions for scrap and recyclable materials
home.heroTitle: Sell surplus materials to recyclers. Buy scrap by open bid.
home.heroBody: Factories, warehouses and contractors list lots of metal, plastic, paper, e-waste and used equipment. Licensed dealers and recyclers bid in the open until the clock runs out.
home.closingEmpty: No lots are live right now. Upcoming lots are listed below.
home.liveNow: {count, plural, =0 {No live lots} one {# lot live now} other {# lots live now}}
home.stats: {live, plural, one {# live lot} other {# live lots}}, {stores, plural, one {# store} other {# stores}} and {bids, plural, one {# bid placed} other {# bids placed}}
home.stepsBody: Every rule is checked by the server at the moment your bid arrives.

rules.minimum: Each bid must be at least the current price plus the lot's increment.
rules.insurance: Some lots require an insurance balance in your wallet. It's a check, not a charge.
rules.clock: The highest bid when the clock reaches zero wins.

home.sellerBody: Apply for a seller account. Once approved, you can list lots, set the starting price and increment, and follow every bid from your portal.
home.badge: A more sustainable future starts here
